## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Mixed short- and medium-term signals — SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +0.51%) and VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +4.43% | 1M: -10.19%) together confirm no clear risk bias.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear has ticked up on the week: VXX (1W: +4.43% | 1M: -10.19%) RECOVERY — short-term jitter amid longer-term decline. Credit conditions neutral: HYG (1W: -0.59% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.56%) BELOW TREND show no systemic stress.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength and slightly tighter rates: UUP (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +2.45%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND points to modestly firmer long-end yields.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Healthcare leading while Tech pulls back: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +1.18%), XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +5.23%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -5.61% | 1M: +6.04%) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US relatively firmer: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +0.51%) versus EM weakness — EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -4.30%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -7.31%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Risk appetite retreating: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -9.10% | 1M: -6.40%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.02% | 1M: -1.80%), IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -17.99% | 1M: -26.09%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base metals pulling back from recent gains: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.01% | 1M: +1.44%). Precious metals weak: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -5.01% | 1M: -8.06%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing relative strength but mixed across fuels: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +1.18%), BNO RECOVERY (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -4.35%), UNG CORRECTION (1W: -2.18% | 1M: +11.67%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed leadership in Energy and Healthcare (XLE, XLV ABOVE TREND). MAJOR divergence across core ETFs — SPY (CORRECTION), XLK (CORRECTION) and sector breadth (4/11) — signals mixed momentum and suppresses a strong directional call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to XLE and XLV as areas showing strength and reduce exposure to high-beta Tech and speculative ETFs such as XLK, ARKK and IBIT; monitor TLT for a clearer duration signal.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +1.18%), XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +5.23%). BEARISH: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -5.61% | 1M: +6.04%), QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +1.34%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG CORRECTION (1W: -2.18% | 1M: +11.67%) and selective energy names (BNO RECOVERY (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -4.35%)). BEARISH: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -5.01% | 1M: -8.06%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -12.21%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (pivot for fear), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health threshold), XLK/XLV relative ratio ~2.0 (growth vs defensive pivot), SPY support zone from recent weekly lows (watch reaction).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals across risk and cycle indicators. Energy and Healthcare showing relative strength while Tech and speculative ETFs display major divergence — monitor VXX/HYG-LQD and SPY/XLK behavior for the next directional clue.
